summary: Qwen's own 2B model, untouched: sees images and video
description: Alibaba's Qwen3.5-2B as released, the starting point for every WesleyQwen. Reads images and video (2 frames a second) and can think step by step before answering. On Wesley's benchmarks: MMLU-Pro 33.7%, ARC-Challenge 79.7%, GSM8K 70.7%. Runs on the RTX 3060 in Wesley's house.

summary: Knows it's WesleyQwen, kept its smarts (QLoRA)
description: Qwen3.5-2B taught that it is WesleyQwen with QLoRA: small adapter weights trained against a 4-bit copy of the model, then merged back in. The gentlest of the three fine-tunes: 100% on identity, ARC-Challenge 80.7% and GSM8K 66.7% (base 79.7% / 70.7%), and the only one whose thinking still works. Sees images and video.

Qwen3.5-2B taught that it is WesleyQwen with LoRA adapters (16.8M trained weights, merged back). 100% on identity and kept most of its ability (ARC-Challenge 77.3%, GSM8K 68.3%), but training only on non-thinking chats taught it to talk about itself inside <think> and never stop, so thinking is switched off. Sees images and video (not yet tried with video).

summary: Every weight retrained on its identity: forgot the most
description: Qwen3.5-2B with all 1.88B language weights fine-tuned on 1000 identity chats. It learned the name perfectly and forgot much of everything else (GSM8K 11.3%, base 70.7%): it pastes identity sentences into maths answers and drifts back to them a few turns into a video chat. Thinking is switched off. Sees images and video.

summary: Google's Gemma 4 E2B: sees and hears, so video comes with its sound
description: Google's Gemma 4 E2B, instruction-tuned, unchanged. The only home model that hears: send it a recording, or a video and it watches the frames and hears the soundtrack together. It hears at most 30 s per clip, so anything longer is walked in 30 s windows, each answered in turn; afterwards only what it said stays in the conversation. Can think before answering. Runs on the RTX 3060 in Wesley's house.
